title: Distilling Metacognitive Behaviors through Agentic Editing
abstract: arXiv:2602.22508v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Distilling long reasoning traces from a teacher model into a smaller student also passes on the teacher's reasoning habits. Prior work and our annotation of teacher traces show that current reasoning models often start without a plan, verify superficially, abandon promising solution paths, and take unchecked shortcuts. We propose Metacognitive Behavioral Tuning (MBT), which inserts seven metacognitive behaviors into teacher traces at the points where the reasoning lacks them and then trains the student on the edited traces. Because teacher traces are long, how the edits are made matters. Rewriting a whole trace at once summarizes long traces, and choosing all insertion points at once crowds them at the start and end. Our agentic method, MBT-A, edits the trace file line by line and records each edit as a git commit, which avoids summarizing long traces and spreads the insertions. translated_title: 通过智能体编辑蒸馏元认知行为
translated_abstract: 将教师模型的长推理链蒸馏到更小的学生模型中时，也会把教师的推理习惯一并传递过去。先前的工作以及我们对教师推理链的标注显示，当前的推理模型常常在没有计划的情况下就开始推理，验证流于表面，放弃有希望的解题路径，并采取未经检查的捷径。我们提出元认知行为微调，在教师推理链中缺乏相应行为的位置插入七种元认知行为，然后在编辑后的推理链上训练学生模型。由于教师推理链很长，如何进行编辑至关重要：一次性重写整条推理链会导致对长推理链的摘要化，而一次性选定所有插入点会使插入集中在开头和结尾。我们的智能体方法 MBT-A 逐行编辑推理链文件，并将每次编辑记录为一次 git 提交，从而避免了对长推理链的摘要化，并使插入点分布更加均匀。在竞赛数学上，经过训练的 Qwen3.5-4B-Base 学生模型取得了改进。
tldr: 提出元认知行为微调（MBT），利用智能体逐行编辑并以 git 提交记录的方式在教师推理链中插入七种元认知行为，再据此训练学生模型，从而改善小模型的推理习惯。
en_tdlr: Proposes Metacognitive Behavioral Tuning (MBT), an agentic line-by-line editing approach that inserts seven metacognitive behaviors into teacher reasoning traces via git-tracked edits, training smaller student models with improved reasoning habits.
